protocol.note: streams model.safetensors one tensor at a time and keeps only what the format stores; no forward pass, so this is weight footprint rather than inference memory

limits: Footprint only: no forward pass runs, so this says how many bytes the stored weights need, not how much memory inference needs.
The packed arrays are this repository's teaching format (uint8 codes plus one float32 scale per 64 weights), not GGUF or bitsandbytes.
lm_head is excluded, as everywhere else in this repository.
Settled RSS also contains the interpreter, the tokenizer and the temporary float32 tensor being packed; the number to compare across rows is held_bytes.
